result.topic_en: Gauss considers products of cubic Gaussian-period-like sums built from p-th roots of unity for primes p ≡ 1 mod 3, finding they take the form P·M with M rational in the cube root of unity, and tabulates factorizations of primes 7, 13, 19, 31, … in the Eisenstein integers a+bρ.
